items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: they usually had a couple of entertainers. Girls. Nettie and Caroline and the James sisters.

ctx.x: Most of the customers, were they colored or white in those clubs along State Street?

More about, oh, I'd say 70 or 75 percent white. At the E-Light and Dreamland and those places. Yeah. We'd get the white crowds around 12 or 1 o'clock every night. See, the E-Light and Dreamland had balcony all the way around. And the whites, a lot of, every night we'd get a bunch of, about 20 or 30 or more white fellas with tuxedos on. So naturally we knew there were musicians coming from that yard around 1 or 1.30. Was there dancing at most of those places or mostly just drinking or what? Yeah. Dancing and…
Nettie and Caroline and the James sisters. Nettie and Caroline and the James sisters. Did you have any trouble with the Prohibition raids in those days? No, no, no, no.
